Product update13 November 2026

What's new in SabkiJeb

The new identity, website and account information, in one place.

A short record of what's live in SabkiJeb. We'll add dated entries here as more features ship, so you can see what changed without reading a roadmap as a promise.

13 November 2026

  • Settlo is now SabkiJeb. The app has a new name and logo. The rebrand does not change your existing data. Read the announcement.
  • A new website. sabkijeb.app explains Spaces, shared expenses, personal loans and paying through your own UPI app. It also brings support and account information together.
  • Terms of use. The Terms explain the service and the role of JOSH Studio, which operates SabkiJeb. SabkiJeb is a record-keeping app, not a bank, payment service or lender.
  • Account deletion information. Open Profile in the app and choose Delete account. If you cannot sign in, email support@sabkijeb.app. Deletion takes effect at once and cannot be undone; records shared with other people stay in their records. The deletion page and privacy policy explain what is removed and what remains.
  • A redesigned palette. Jade, forest green and marigold bring the new identity into the app and website, with light and dark themes.

Availability

SabkiJeb is free to use and currently available through the iPhone TestFlight beta. Android is planned for later; there is no public App Store or Google Play release yet. Email us about beta access if you'd like to try it.
